The issuer exhibits strong financial health, characterized by solid profitability (operating margin of 15% and net income of $334M) and a very robust balance sheet with low leverage (equity-to-assets ratio of 62%) and excellent liquidity (current ratio of 2.48). While these metrics reflect an investment-grade profile with low default risk, the absolute size of the company (revenue of $3.1B and assets of $4.9B) limits its ability to achieve the highest investment grades (AAA/AA range) which are typically reserved for much larger, globally diversified enterprises. Consequently, a strong upper-medium grade is highly appropriate for this credit profile.

DECISION: A-
